triggers: a kernel on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942) risks the '9. Removing The M=1 Stream Packet Boundary' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on AMD MI308X (CDNA3 / gfx942): 9. Removing The M=1 Stream Packet Boundary

problem.statement: Pitfalls: FlyDSL FP8 PTPC Fused MoE on MI308X -- 9. Removing The M=1 Stream Packet Boundary

payload.attempted: Delete the M=1 stream marker because it launches no CUDA kernel and appears to be overhead-free dead code.
payload.lesson: Preserve the M=1 stream packet boundary unless a replacement is validated by trace guard, stage1/stage2 sums, and repeated e2e checks.

established_fact.mechanism: The stream packet boundary preserves the timing boundary that the old `.item()` host sync accidentally provided, without adding host sync or profiler-visible memcpy.

payload.observed: M=1 stage1 and e2e timing become bimodal. The small-row profile can fail parity even when the classified kernels are otherwise aligned.
payload.root_cause: The stream packet boundary preserves the timing boundary that the old `.item()` host sync accidentally provided, without adding host sync or profiler-visible memcpy.
